name: Miscellaneous Movement Disorder Due to Neurodegenerative Disease

criteria.description: Progressive onset of motor symptoms including tremor, rigidity, or bradykinesia
Exclusion of secondary causes such as drug-induced or metabolic movement disorders
Neuroimaging findings consistent with neurodegeneration (e.g., basal ganglia atrophy)
Presence of atypical features not fully consistent with Parkinson's disease or other defined syndromes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Progressive motor symptoms with exclusion of other causes; supportive neuroimaging and atypical features strengthen diagnosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and by exclusion; no standardized diagnostic criteria currently available

pathognomonic.symptomName: Atypical parkinsonism with mixed movement abnormalities
pathognomonic.notes: Combination of tremor, rigidity, and dystonia atypical for classic Parkinson's disease
searchTerms: Parkinson-like symptoms with mixed movement problems
atypical Parkinson's disease with varied motor issues
unusual Parkinsonism with multiple movement abnormalities
slow movements worsening over time not helped by medication
progressive slowness of movement unresponsive to treatment
frequent falling due to poor balance
difficulty speaking clearly with low volume
problems with automatic body functions including low blood pressure when standing
autonomic nervous system dysfunction causing dizziness
eye movement problems with slow rapid eye movements

occasional.symptomName: Sleep disturbances including REM sleep behavior disorder
searchTerms: sleep problems including acting out dreams

laboratory: Routine blood tests typically normal; exclude metabolic causes
CSF analysis may show nonspecific neurodegenerative markers
imaging: MRI showing basal ganglia atrophy or signal changes
FDG-PET demonstrating hypometabolism in affected brain regions
genetic: No specific genetic markers identified; some cases may have familial aggregation
other: Levodopa challenge test typically shows poor or no response
Neurophysiological studies may reveal abnormal motor evoked potentials

distinguishingFeatures: Prominent autonomic failure early in disease
Characteristic MRI hot cross bun sign

redFlags: Poor or no response to dopaminergic therapy
